body.en: *Transcription* copies genetic information from one strand of DNA into RNA. A transcription unit has a promoter, a structural gene and a terminator. The template strand has 3'→5' polarity; the other, the coding strand, has the same sequence as the RNA except that T replaces U. The promoter lies towards the 5' end (upstream) of the coding strand. In bacteria, one RNA polymerase makes all RNAs; it binds σ (sigma) factor to initiate and ρ (rho) factor to terminate. Bacterial mRNA can be translated even before transcription ends, since there is no nuclear membrane.
body.kn: ಪ್ರತಿಲೇಖನ ಘಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರವರ್ತಕ, ರಚನಾತ್ಮಕ ಜೀನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಅಂತಕಾರಕ ಇವೆ. ಟೆಂಪ್ಲೇಟ್ ಎಳೆ 3'→5'; ಸಂಕೇತ ಎಳೆ RNAಯಂತೆಯೇ ಅನುಕ್ರಮ ಹೊಂದಿದೆ. ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಟೀರಿಯಾದಲ್ಲಿ σ ಅಂಶ ಆರಂಭಕ್ಕೆ, ρ ಅಂಶ ಅಂತ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ.

narration.en: Transcription and processing turn a split gene into a mature messenger RNA. Put the steps in order.

prompt.en: Arrange the steps from a gene to a mature eukaryotic mRNA.
prompt.kn: ಜೀನ್‌ನಿಂದ ಪಕ್ವ ಯೂಕ್ಯಾರಿಯೋಟಿಕ್ mRNA ವರೆಗಿನ ಹಂತಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸಿ.

steps.en: RNA polymerase binds the promoter (with an initiation factor) and opens the DNA
Elongation: ribonucleoside triphosphates are added, copying the template strand
At the terminator, the polymerase and the new RNA are released
Splicing: the introns of the hnRNA are removed and the exons joined
Capping: methyl guanosine triphosphate is added at the 5' end
Tailing: 200–300 adenylate residues are added at the 3' end
The mature mRNA leaves the nucleus for translation

explanation.en: RNA polymerase binds the promoter and initiates, elongates using the template strand, and stops at the terminator. In eukaryotes the hnRNA made by RNA polymerase II is capped at the 5' end, spliced to remove introns and tailed with 200–300 adenylates at the 3' end, then leaves the nucleus. (Capping and tailing can be learnt in either order around splicing; NCERT lists splicing first.)
explanation.kn: ಆರಂಭ → ವಿಸ್ತರಣೆ → ಅಂತ್ಯ → ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿ ಜೋಡಣೆ, ಟೋಪಿ, ಬಾಲ → ಕೋಶಕೇಂದ್ರದಿಂದ ಹೊರಗೆ.

body.en: Eukaryotes have three RNA polymerases: RNA pol I makes rRNAs (28S, 18S, 5.8S), RNA pol II makes the precursor of mRNA, hnRNA, and RNA pol III makes tRNA, 5S rRNA and snRNAs. *Eukaryotic* genes are split: coding exons alternate with non-coding introns. hnRNA is processed by splicing (introns removed, exons joined), capping (methyl guanosine triphosphate added at the 5' end) and tailing (200–300 adenylate residues added at the 3' end), and is then exported as mRNA. Bacterial genes are usually polycistronic; eukaryotic genes are mostly monocistronic.
body.kn: ಯೂಕ್ಯಾರಿಯೋಟ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂರು RNA ಪಾಲಿಮರೇಸ್‌ಗಳು: I – rRNA, II – hnRNA, III – tRNA, 5S rRNA, snRNA. ಎಕ್ಸಾನ್‌ಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಇಂಟ್ರಾನ್‌ಗಳು. ಸ್ಪ್ಲೈಸಿಂಗ್, ಕ್ಯಾಪಿಂಗ್ ಮತ್ತು ಟೈಲಿಂಗ್ ನಂತರ hnRNA mRNA ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ.
